summary: Iteration 7 testing completed - Saved Cards, Auto-Reload, Admin Payouts, Subscriptions Cancel. All 38 backend tests passed (3 skipped due to insufficient creator balance). Frontend testing verified all new UI components and flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Saved cards are SIMULATED (no real Stripe token) - clearly labeled DEMO in UI
Auto-reload scheduler runs every 15 min with _run_renewals() - creates payment_transactions with simulated=true
Admin payouts correctly requires role='admin' - non-admin gets 403
Payout reject correctly refunds coins via _credit_wallet(reason='payout_refund')
Subscription cancel sets auto_renew=false and cancelled_at, keeps access until expires_at
Profile chip correctly links to /subscriptions for fan and /dashboard for creator
Admin link (nav-admin) correctly hidden for non-admin users
seed_data_creation: Fan has ~480 coins, 4 active subscriptions. Creator (Lyse Press) has 100 coins, 1 pending payout request (500 coins).
